properties.description: Detects 5 or more failed logons (event 4625) for the same account on the same host within a 10-minute sliding window. Possible password guessing or brute force. Validated with a controlled runas test.
properties.query:
// T1110.001 - Repeated failed logons (sliding window) - rule query v0.3 (event time = LastFailure)
// Rule settings: run every 10 min, lookback 1 h
// Counts 4625 per Computer + TargetUserName in any 10-min sliding window (1-min steps).
// Alerts only if at least one failure was ingested in the last run interval (newData),
// so one burst does not alert on every run.
let threshold = 5;
let window = 10;          // minutes
let lookback = 1h;
let newData = 10m;        // = run frequency
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where EventID == 4625
| extend IngestTime = ingestion_time()
| extend FailureType = case(
    SubStatus =~ "0xc000006a", "Wrong password (account exists)",
    SubStatus =~ "0xc0000064", "User does not exist",
    SubStatus =~ "0xc0000234", "Account locked out",
    SubStatus =~ "0xc0000072", "Account disabled",
    strcat("Other (", SubStatus, ")"))
| mv-expand k = range(0, window - 1, 1) to typeof(int)
| extend WindowStart = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m) - 1m * k
| summarize FailedCount = dcount(strcat(tostring(TimeGenerated), EventData)),
            FirstFailure = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastFailure = max(TimeGenerated),
            LatestIngest = max(IngestTime),
            LogonTypes = make_set(LogonType),
            LogonProcesses = make_set(trim(" ", LogonProcessName)),
            FailureTypes = make_set(FailureType)
            by Computer, TargetUserName, WindowStart
| where FailedCount >= threshold
| summarize FailedCount = max(FailedCount),
            FirstFailure = min(FirstFailure),
            LastFailure = max(LastFailure),
            LatestIngest = max(LatestIngest),
            LogonTypes = make_set(LogonTypes),
            LogonProcesses = make_set(LogonProcesses),
            FailureTypes = make_set(FailureTypes)
            by Computer, TargetUserName
| where LatestIngest > ago(newData)
| extend AccountName = TargetUserName, HostName = Computer

| extend TimeGenerated = LastFailure

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{FailedCount}} failed logons in a 10-minute window. Failure type: {{FailureTypes}}
